name: Fanghouse
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Sankt Anton am Arlberg**

Discover the heart of the Alps in **Tirol**, where adventure and tradition meet. **Sankt Anton am Arlberg** is a world-famous ski and hiking paradise, nestled between the majestic **Lechquellengebirge** and **Vergentlalm** mountain ranges. Whether you're shredding the slopes, exploring pristine trails, or soaking in the breathtaking scenery, this alpine gem promises unforgettable experiences.

After an action-packed day, unwind in one of our cozy **Hütten** (mountain huts) or enjoy a hearty meal featuring local specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a steaming bowl of **Käsespätzle**. The warm hospitality and rustic charm of **Tirol** will make you feel right at home.

**Innsbruck**, the vibrant capital of **Tirol**, is just a short drive away, offering a mix of culture, history, and modern flair. Don’t miss the stunning **Goldenes Dachl**, the charming **Altstadt**, or a scenic ride on the **Nordkette** cable car for panoramic views of the Alps.

From winter wonderlands to summer hiking trails, **Sankt Anton am Arlberg** is your ultimate alpine escape. **Willkommen in Tirol!**
